# Brasil 2030: Energia para Escolher

> Working scenario about how Brazil can argue for a global AI slowdown, mediate US-China talks, and turn energy and data centers into bargaining power and inference sovereignty. Public draft, last updated 2026-08-19.

## Evidence warning

Observed facts, developer claims, author estimates, and narrative inventions carry separate labels. The September 2026 Camila and Lourdes scene, Brazilian mediation channel, limited 2030 protocol, and 2029 inference-tier mechanism are scenario inventions. Pedro's 2030 compute-model values remain open.
